name: OpenCode Harness Host
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p "$HOME/src" && if [ ! -d "$HOME/src/opencode-config/.git" ]; then gh repo clone theDRElabs/opencode-config "$HOME/src/opencode-config" -- -b phone/termux-setup || git clone -b phone/termux-setup https://github.com/theDRElabs/opencode-config.git "$HOME/src/opencode-config"; fi && bash "$HOME/src/opencode-config/bootstrap.sh"
